verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduling of jobs or workflows is a fair question for a virtual mailbox service, for example scheduled forwarding or batch scans. The evidence shows only one-off actions via the API and MCP server (scan, shred, tag) and automatic AI labeling. Nothing documents a recurring schedule or a workflow scheduler, and building one externally on the API would be a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
